name: Cloudflare
description: Cloudflare API for managing accounts, zones, tokens and other Cloudflare services, with SDKs and Terraform provider.
auth_notes: API tokens (recommended) created by the developer; legacy Global API key plus account email also supported. Token format and permission groups are configurable.
gate_detail: Developers create an API token themselves; no plan requirement is stated for token creation. Some endpoints (e.g. Organizations read/update/delete) need a Global API key. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: REST API with account, token, audit log and billing endpoints plus TypeScript, Python and Go libraries and a Terraform provider.
mcp_notes: Cloudflare runs managed remote MCP servers with OAuth, including a main API MCP server covering the full API; main server URL not stated.
blocker_detail: No payment or approval gate stated; some endpoints require the legacy Global API key.

evidence.quote: Create an API token to grant access to the API to perform actions.
You can also authenticate with API keys , but these keys have several limitations that make them less secure than API tokens.
reading, updating, or deleting an Organization requires a Global API key and your registered email address.
Cloudflare runs a catalog of managed remote MCP servers which you can connect to using OAuth
the Cloudflare API MCP server already covers the full Cloudflare API.

issues: Plan requirements for creating API tokens are not stated.
URL of the main Cloudflare API MCP server is not given in the sources.
Webhook support inferred from notification and stream webhook sections in the API listing.
